about: Real and test-suite PDFs collected 2026-11-18 for the table and formula checks, from 25 hosts (manifest of all 54 downloads: the verapdf-experiment worktree's artifacts/real-pdfs/manifest.jsonl, not in git). Each file is judged only on the checks in judged_checks (table_rows_fault: fails either table check, for test-suite files whose verdicts predate the split; true: should fail; false: should pass; null: disputed or unsure, not scored), with the basis. Test-suite files (kind) have an outside verdict; real-world files have none: they were judged by an agent from the rendered page and the tags, not by a person with a screen reader. Real-world tables flagged but not looked at (Wilkes, ETSI, Urban Institute, UK Treasury, Ealing, Wandsworth) are left out. Real-world tables the check passes are not labelled either, so this set says nothing about the check's recall on real files.
